title: إِنَّ and Its Sisters
lede: Modify a nominal sentence to express emphasis, reported thought, reason, contrast, hope, wish and resemblance.

items.prompt: Choose the correct emphasis: “Indeed, the lesson is useful.”
items.feedback: إِنَّ places its noun in the accusative and leaves the predicate nominative.
أَنَّ links the reported idea after a verb such as أَعْتَقِدُ.
The attached pronoun is the noun of أَنَّ; the predicate remains nominative.
لَعَلَّ commonly expresses hope or possibility.
لَيْتَ introduces a wished-for situation.

items.prompt: Which contrast form contains a pronoun?
items.feedback: لَكِنَّ may take an attached pronoun: لَكِنَّهُ.
The subject becomes accusative; the predicate remains nominative.
أَنَّ follows the reporting verb.
The attached feminine pronoun is the noun; predicate agrees and stays nominative.

items.prompt: Choose “It is as though the city is asleep.”
items.feedback: كَأَنَّ introduces comparison or appearance.

items.prompt: Which particle adds emphasis at the start?
items.feedback: إِنَّ commonly opens an emphatic statement.

items.prompt: Which follows أَعْرِفُ in “I know that…”?
items.feedback: أَنَّ connects the subordinate content.
Ism inna accusative; khabar nominative.
The attached pronoun is feminine; the predicate agrees.

items.prompt: Which means “perhaps the exam is easy”?
items.feedback: لَعَلَّ expresses hope/possibility.

items.prompt: Which means “I wish the holiday were longer”?
items.feedback: لَيْتَ introduces a wish.

items.prompt: Which means “as though the sea is a mirror”?
items.feedback: كَأَنَّ expresses resemblance.
Plural pronoun and human plural predicate agree.
Correct spelling and nominative predicate.

options: Learn each particle with its meaning, sentence frame and one model.
Add إِنَّ to every paragraph sentence.
Memorise case labels without using the structures.
items.feedback: Functional frames turn grammar into usable communication.

games.p: I think that the plan is useful.
games.e: أَنَّ links the content after a reporting verb.
The attached feminine pronoun is the noun of لَكِنَّ.

games.p: I wish the weekend were longer.
as though the sky is a painting

games.e: Pronoun and human plural predicate agree.

blocks: ## Why this matters لِمَاذَا نَسْتَعْمِلُ إِنَّ وَأَخَوَاتِهَا؟
These particles let you emphasise, report, contrast, hope, wish and compare ideas in connected speech and writing.
### Core
Use إِنَّ, أَنَّ and لِأَنَّ in accurate everyday frames.
### Develop
Add لَكِنَّ, لَعَلَّ and attached pronouns.
### Stretch
Use لَيْتَ and كَأَنَّ with case-aware control.
[callout] Communication target: move beyond separate basic sentences by showing emphasis, reason, reporting, contrast and attitude.
## Diagnostic start
Check which meanings and endings are already secure.
## The core change after إِنَّ
The underlying nominal sentence remains, but the first part changes case.
[callout] Pattern: إِنَّ + اسْمَهَا الْمَنْصُوبَ + خَبَرَهَا الْمَرْفُوعَ

TABLE: Before | After إِنَّ | Meaning // الطَّالِبُ مُجْتَهِدٌ. | إِنَّ الطَّالِبَ مُجْتَهِدٌ. | Indeed, the student is hardworking. // الْمَدْرَسَةُ كَبِيرَةٌ. | إِنَّ الْمَدْرَسَةَ كَبِيرَةٌ. | Indeed, the school is large. // الطُّلَّابُ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ. | إِنَّ الطُّلَّابَ مُسْتَعِدُّونَ. | Indeed, the students are ready.
[callout/warning] Do not move both endings: the predicate does not become accusative simply because إِنَّ appears.
## إِنَّ at the start; أَنَّ inside a larger sentence
The two particles share grammar but serve different linking roles.

TABLE: Use | Frame | Model // opening emphasis | إِنَّ... | إِنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ مُهِمٌّ. // reported thought | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ... | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ مُهِمٌّ. // knowledge | أَعْرِفُ أَنَّ... | أَعْرِفُ أَنَّ الطَّرِيقَ طَوِيلٌ. // reason | لِأَنَّ... | أَدْرُسُ لِأَنَّ الِامْتِحَانَ قَرِيبٌ.
[callout] Practical distinction: start an independent emphatic statement with إِنَّ ; introduce the content after a reporting verb with أَنَّ .
## Attached pronouns make fluent clauses
The pronoun can serve as the noun of the particle.

TABLE: Person | Form | Model // I | إِنَّنِي / إِنِّي | إِنَّنِي مُسْتَعِدَّةٌ. // you m. | إِنَّكَ | إِنَّكَ مُجْتَهِدٌ. // you f. | إِنَّكِ | إِنَّكِ مُجْتَهِدَةٌ. // he/it m. | إِنَّهُ | إِنَّهُ مُفِيدٌ. // she/it f. | إِنَّهَا | إِنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ. // we | إِنَّنَا | إِنَّنَا مُسْتَعِدُّونَ. // they | إِنَّهُمْ / إِنَّهُنَّ | إِنَّهُمْ نَاجِحُونَ.
[callout] High-value frame: أُفَضِّلُ الْقِرَاءَةَ لِأَنَّهَا مُفِيدَةٌ وَمُمْتِعَةٌ.
## A functional map of the main sisters
Learn the communicative job of each particle before memorising labels.

TABLE: Particle | Communicative job | Model // لَكِنَّ | strong contrast | الطَّرِيقُ طَوِيلٌ، لَكِنَّهُ آمِنٌ. // لَعَلَّ | hope or possibility | لَعَلَّ الطَّقْسَ جَمِيلٌ غَدًا. // لَيْتَ | wish | لَيْتَ الْعُطْلَةَ أَطْوَلُ. // كَأَنَّ | resemblance / appearance | كَأَنَّ الْبَحْرَ مِرْآةٌ.
[callout/warning] لَكِنْ versus لَكِنَّ: لَكِنْ can link a new clause without governing a noun; لَكِنَّ follows the inna pattern and often appears with an attached pronoun: لَكِنَّهُ .
## Misconception clinic
Correct meaning, spelling and grammatical effect.

TABLE: Draft | Improved version | Reason // إِنَّ الطَّالِبُ مُجْتَهِدًا. | إِنَّ الطَّالِبَ مُجْتَهِدٌ. | Noun accusative; predicate nominative. // أَعْتَقِدُ إِنَّ الْخُطَّةَ جَيِّدَةٌ. | أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ الْخُطَّةَ جَيِّدَةٌ. | Reported content uses أَنَّ. // لِأَنَّهُ مُفِيدًا. | لِأَنَّهُ مُفِيدٌ. | Predicate remains nominative. // لَكِنُّهُ | لَكِنَّهُ | Correct vowel and spelling. // لَعَلَّ الطَّالِبُ نَاجِحًا. | لَعَلَّ الطَّالِبَ نَاجِحٌ. | Same inna-family case pattern.
## Game: Choose the particle
Select the particle that expresses the intended relationship.
## Skills workshop
Use particles to make a short opinion genuinely connected.
[ar] أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ التَّعَلُّمَ عَنْ بُعْدٍ مُفِيدٌ، لَكِنَّهُ يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى تَنْظِيمٍ جَيِّدٍ.
[ar] لَعَلَّ التِّقْنِيَّةَ تُسَاعِدُنَا أَكْثَرَ فِي الْمُسْتَقْبَلِ، لِأَنَّهَا تَتَطَوَّرُ بِسُرْعَةٍ.
### Write a connected opinion
Write 100–120 Arabic words about school, technology, travel or leisure.
[callout] Success checklist: Use أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّ, one إِنَّ statement, لِأَنَّ or لِأَنَّهُ/هَا, one contrast with لَكِنَّ, and one hope/wish form.
[callout] Paper route: Write the paragraph and colour-code the noun and predicate after two particles.
## Final mastery check
Choose particles for meaning and preserve the inna-family structure.
### What you can now do
- Use إِنَّ for emphasis and أَنَّ after reporting verbs.
- Build reason and contrast clauses with attached pronouns.
- Use لَعَلَّ, لَيْتَ and كَأَنَّ for attitude and comparison.
- Protect the noun/predicate case pattern in supported writing.
Spaced revisit: rewrite one old paragraph by replacing repeated وَ with three purposeful particle frames.
